protocol.name: engdesign-native-verifier
protocol.grader: Unchanged upstream evaluate_llm_response in a separate grader container; original same-interpreter candidate execution remains a native limitation.
protocol.runtime_dependencies: Task-specific Python scientific libraries; Octave; Icarus Verilog; configurable Webots image for XZ_03/XZ_04
notes: Every upstream open task is selectable. Runtime requirements are checked explicitly; missing infrastructure is never recorded as a wrong answer.
Published native grader defects are documented per task; scoring rules are not silently repaired.
AB_02 and AB_03 omit reference images from agent inputs; the upstream generic image collector also includes those images. Native graders still receive them.
XZ_03/XZ_04 resolve the two R2025a background PROTO URIs to identical pinned local simulator assets for offline verification; original and patched world hashes are recorded.
Native failed verdicts with null score or confidence retain those unknown values in verdict.json; reward.json contains only known numeric metrics.
